lines.text: God says Jerusalem clings to deceit and refuses to return, and everyone pursues his own course like a horse charging into battle.
God says the stork knows her seasons, but His people do not know His requirements, and the lying pen of the priests has produced deception.
God says from prophet to priest all practice deceit, and they have no shame at all and do not know how to blush.
God will take away their harvest, and the people say they will flee to the high mountains and perish there.
The snorting of enemy horses is heard from Dan, and God will send vipers that cannot be charmed.
